[Tokyo] Categories： Izakaya (Japanese style tavern) Robatayaki Seafood Budget： JPY 4,000 - JPY 4,999 JPY 1,000 - JPY 1,999 Restaurant information(detail) Overview Seating Menu Photos 2016 Reviews 250 Map 【4-minute walk from Nakano Station】Maximize the potential of seasonal fresh fish and vegetables with robatayaki. Private rooms available. Experience a culinary journey that stimulates all five senses with seasonal ingredients woven together by the changing seasons.《Commitment to Japanese Cuisine》Indulge in robatayaki made with carefully...Read more Specialities Food [Signature Dish] A Variety of Specialty Dishes Featuring Carefully Selected Ingredients, Including Robatayaki Food 【Commitment to Ingredients】From our signature Robatayaki to seafood, Wagyu beef, and eel. We can accommodate last-minute banquets as well. Enjoy pairing it with your favorite dishes! Reserve Set menu details JPY2,200（Price including tax）per person 2 - 99 [Sumika Introduction] 9 Dishes Course with Charcoal Grilled Yamagata Pork Loin, Silver Cod, and Donko Shiitake Mushrooms, "Sumi~SUMI~" JPY 5,5009 items Start with an assorted platter of four appetizers, followed by exquisite salt-braised Wagyu beef tendon, and our specialty grilled Donko shiitake mushrooms and grilled Gindara marinated in Saikyo miso. The main dish features Yamagata pork loin, slowly grilled over charcoal, delivering an irresistible combination of rich flavor and smoky aroma. To finish, enjoy grilled rice balls and Aosa seaweed miso soup, along with dessert, all at a reasonable price that guarantees satisfaction. Reserve Set menu details JPY5,500（Price including tax）per person 2 - 99 Recommended Gourmet Feast: 9 Dishes including Charcoal-Grilled Yamagata Pork Loin and Wagyu Strip Loin Sushi "HANA" JPY 7,0009 items Experience a seasonal course that begins with delightful appetizers. For the main dish, we offer rich, marinated silver cod and flavorful Yamagata pork, expertly grilled over charcoal for an exquisite taste. Enjoy melt-in-your-mouth Wagyu strip loin sushi as part of the rice dish, ensuring satisfaction until the very end. For dessert, we also provide ice cream. Indulge in a variety of gourmet dishes in a serene atmosphere.
